name: cure-image-viewer
description: Draws the images you sent above the prompt until the turn that carried them ends. Pictures need a terminal with the kitty graphics protocol (kitty, Ghostty, Warp); elsewhere each shows as a caption with its size.

imageDir.title: Image folder
imageDir.description: The folder Claude Code saves pasted images in (`<N>.png`), when the default guess is wrong. Empty: guess. CURE_IMAGE_DIR overrides it.
